description: An 18-year-old Black athlete vanishes on a Mississippi barrier island with white friends. His body washes ashore two days later. His phone was found wiped clean in their possession. One of them is the son of a sitting judge. Authorities say no foul play. The family says the story doesn't add up.

faqs.answer: Nolan Xavier Wells was an 18-year-old Black student-athlete from Ocean Springs, Mississippi. He played wide receiver at Southwest Mississippi Community College and was a multisport athlete at Ocean Springs High School. He went missing on July 4, 2026 during a trip to Horn Island with friends. His body was recovered two days later.
faqs.question: Who was Nolan Wells?

faqs.answer: Key contradictions include: friends claim Nolan chose to stay on the island, but his parents and character witnesses say he would never do that; the girl he was with says he told her he was returning to the boat, but friends say he said he was staying with her; Nolan's phone was found in the friends' possession with all Snapchat data wiped; there is video of an altercation where someone demands their phone; and all friends lawyered up and scrubbed social media.
faqs.question: What are the main contradictions in the case?

faqs.answer: Ashlee Cole is a Chancery Court Judge in Jackson County, Mississippi. Her stepson Warren was one of the friends on the boat with Nolan Wells. She deactivated her social media accounts after public scrutiny, then issued a Facebook statement to 'dispel rumors' about her family's involvement. Her position as a sitting judge in the same county where the investigation is being handled has raised questions about conflicts of interest.
faqs.question: Who is Judge Ashlee Cole and what is her connection to the case?

faqs.answer: Nolan's family has retained civil rights attorney Ben Crump, who has also involved Rev. Al Sharpton. Colin Kaepernick funded an independent autopsy in Washington, D.C. because the family does not trust Mississippi authorities. Tyler Perry offered to pay for the funeral. Rep. Bennie Thompson has called for a transparent investigation. The family has raised over $380,000 through GoFundMe.
faqs.question: What is the family doing to seek justice?

faqs.answer: Horn Island is a barrier island about 10 miles off the Mississippi Gulf Coast. It is part of the Gulf Islands National Seashore and is accessible only by private boat. According to the National Park Service, there is no staff, drinking water, shelter, facilities, or communication on the island. This isolation is central to the case, as Nolan was reportedly left behind with no way to call for help.
faqs.question: What is Horn Island and why is it significant?

leadParagraph: Nolan Xavier Wells, an 18-year-old Black football player, went to Horn Island with white friends on July 4, 2026 and never came back. His friends left without him, took his phone, and wiped it clean. One friend is the stepson of a Jackson County judge. Now Ben Crump, Al Sharpton, and Colin Kaepernick are demanding answers in a case that echoes Mississippi's darkest history.

mainImage.caption: Nolan Wells' parents Christine and Elmore Wonsley appear on CBS Mornings with attorney Ben Crump, calling for a thorough investigation into their son's death on Horn Island.

methodology: Reported using open-source intelligence from 12+ news outlets including CNN, CBS News, ABC News, NPR, the Biloxi Sun Herald, WLOX, and others. Cross-referenced official statements from the Jackson County Sheriff's Office, Judge Ashlee Cole's public Facebook statement, Ben Crump's press conferences, and family interviews on Good Morning America and CBS Mornings. Verified timeline contradictions from multiple independent sources.
title: The Death of Nolan Wells: A Story That Doesn't Add Up
